analysis.purpose: The extractor plugin contract: one file in, nodes and intra-file edges out, deterministic and never calling a model — plus the capability declaration that states what each extractor does NOT do.
responsibilities: Define the extractor interface every language plugin implements
Carry a capability declaration alongside the results

businessRules.rule: An extractor handles ONE file and emits intra-file edges only; cross-file work belongs to the resolver.
businessRules.rationale: It cannot see other files, so anything else would be a guess.

businessRules.rule: Extractors are deterministic and never call a model.
businessRules.rationale: The extracted layer must be reproducible byte-for-byte.

nodes.name: Extractor contract
nodes.summary: The plugin interface every language implements.
